mapper.select: SELECT id, contract_id, change_code, change_type, change_reason, before_value, after_value, amount_delta, impact_analysis, status, applicant_id, applicant_name, approver_id, approver_name, approved_at, workflow_id, tenant_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_contract_change WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, contract_id, change_code, change_type, change_reason, before_value, after_value, amount_delta, impact_analysis, status, applicant_id, applicant_name, approver_id, approver_name, approved_at, workflow_id, tenant_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_contract_change WHERE change_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_project_contract_change SET status = #{status}, approver_id = COALESCE(#{approverId}, approver_id), approver_name = COALESCE(#{approverName}, approver_name), approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE approved_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
